item.title: Abaco Shantytown, Andros Plane Crash, Court of Appeals
item.ns0:title: Abaco Shantytown, Andros Plane Crash, Court of Appeals
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, authorities confirm Abaco is on the upcoming demolition list after a viral video sparks fresh public concern over unregulated shanty town communities. Search teams off North Andros make a major breakthrough in the investigation into the tragic plane crash that claimed four lives, while the Court of Appeal makes history with its first sitting outside New Providence in nearly two decades. We also pause to reflect on the 25th anniversary of 9/11 and its lasting impact on Bahamian national security, alongside updates on environmental concerns and school disruptions. Tune in for all these headlines, progress on the new hospital project, your weekend sports, and the full weather forecast!
